conditions.input: Visible UI and physical keyboard only. Public server snapshots observed read-only.
conditions.noInjection: No state, clock, WebSocket command or fake event injection.
conditions.dropFixture: Server/test/fixtures/dart-drops.mjs, test subprocess only; no production random-distribution claim.
conditions.frameEvidence: Canvas PNGs sampled read-only from actual rAF frames; visual review still required.
conditions.performanceLimits: Bounded rAF interval samples on shared host; page count is recorded per sample and one video is active; excludes PNG windows. Not production SLO, render CPU timing, service capacity, or human playtesting.
